scoring_justification: Checker recomputes expected limits from reported parameters and validates agent's computed Cv and S against those limits and against a direct recomputation of the Debye model to confirm correct implementation.

outputs.description: Verification of the generalized Debye model limits: the file provides parameters and computed thermodynamic quantities for the solid-limit, gas-limit specific heat, and an ideal-gas entropy check, along with computed relative errors. The checker recomputes the expected limits from the parameters and validates that the reported relative errors do not exceed a hidden tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The task is scoped to the limit-verification aspect of the generalized Debye model. Full neon-specific determination of Θ_D(v) and construction of p(v,T) surfaces are excluded because they require external tabulated data that is not publicly accessible.

steps.description: Verification of solid limit Cv, gas limit Cv, and ideal‑gas entropy
